resolution.note: A linked worktree owns its own task records; only the main checkout forwards to the claiming worktree.

title: Closing a task inside a lane worktree writes the record in that worktree
body:
Why: three lanes on 2026-11-12 (#622, #625, #626) ran `krn task close <id>` inside their worktree and it rewrote tasks/<id>.json in the main checkout, where the lead claim lives; each lane copied the record back by hand and one push failed the Task records lint (exit 65).
Outcome: `krn task close` run inside a lane worktree writes the record in that worktree (the claim is resolved from the main checkout but the write goes to the cwd worktree), and the main checkout stays clean.
Proof: a task CLI test with a main checkout and a linked worktree closes a lead-claimed task from the worktree and asserts only the worktree file changed.
Scope: src/task/, test/task/.
